mapper.sql: backup_record_id, backup_no, backup_type, backup_status, backup_key, file_name, file_size_bytes, date_format(started_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as started_time, date_format(completed_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as completed_time, date_format(retention_until, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as retention_until, failure_reason, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time
mapper.select:
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_backup_record
is_delete = 0 and backup_type = #{query.backupType} and backup_status = #{query.backupStatus}
and (backup_no like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or backup_key like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or file_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
order by started_time desc, backup_record_id desc
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_backup_record where backup_key = #{backupKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_backup_record (backup_no, backup_type, backup_status, backup_key, file_name, file_size_bytes, started_time, completed_time, retention_until, failure_reason, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{backupNo}, #{backupType}, #{backupStatus}, #{backupKey}, #{fileName}, #{fileSizeBytes}, #{startedTime}, #{completedTime}, #{retentionUntil}, #{failureReason}, #{operator}, now(), #{operator}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_backup_record where backup_status = 1 and is_delete = 0 order by completed_time desc, backup_record_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_backup_record where backup_status = #{backupStatus} and is_delete = 0
mapper.sql: storage_ledger_id, scope_type, scope_key, scope_name, capacity_bytes, used_bytes, available_bytes, changed_bytes, change_type, snapshot_source, date_format(measured_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as measured_time, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time
mapper.select:
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger
is_delete = 0 and scope_type = #{query.scopeType}
and (scope_key like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or scope_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or snapshot_source like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
order by measured_time desc, storage_ledger_id desc

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger current_row where current_row.scope_type = #{scopeType} and current_row.scope_key = #{scopeKey} and current_row.is_delete = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger newer_row where newer_row.scope_type = current_row.scope_type and newer_row.scope_key = current_row.scope_key and newer_row.is_delete = 0 and (newer_row.measured_time > current_row.measured_time or (newer_row.measured_time = current_row.measured_time and newer_row.storage_ledger_id > current_row.storage_ledger_id)) ) limit 1

select coalesce(sum(current_row.used_bytes), 0) as latest_used_bytes, coalesce(sum(current_row.available_bytes), 0) as latest_available_bytes, date_format(max(current_row.measured_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as latest_measured_time from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger current_row where current_row.is_delete = 0 and not exists ( select 1 from ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger newer_row where newer_row.scope_type = current_row.scope_type and newer_row.scope_key = current_row.scope_key and newer_row.is_delete = 0 and (newer_row.measured_time > current_row.measured_time or (newer_row.measured_time = current_row.measured_time and newer_row.storage_ledger_id > current_row.storage_ledger_id)) )
select coalesce(sum(data_length + index_length), 0) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = database()
mapper.insert: insert into ry_rental.ry_rental_platform_storage_quota_ledger (scope_type, scope_key, scope_name, capacity_bytes, used_bytes, available_bytes, changed_bytes, change_type, snapshot_source, measured_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, #{scopeName}, #{capacityBytes}, #{usedBytes}, #{availableBytes}, #{changedBytes}, #{changeType}, #{snapshotSource}, #{measuredTime}, #{operator}, now(), #{operator}, now(), 0)
